correctness.rationale: For scalar |a|>1, Q>0, R>0, h!=0, each received update g(P)=Q+(a^2 R P)/(h^2 P+R) lies in [Q,Q+a^2 R/h^2], independent of previous P. After N>=1 losses, f^N(g(P))=B^N g(P)+Q(B^N-1)/(B-1) with B=a^2, giving deterministic Q B^N<=M<=C_+ B^N. For the staged transient kernel T=pI+cJ, the exact binomial expansion e1^T T^(n-1)1=Σ_{j=0}^{min(m-1,n-1)}C(n-1,j) p^(n-1-j)c^j follows for all m>=2, n>=1; its dominant j=m-1 term has survival asymptotic [c^(m-1)/((m-1)!p^m)]n^(m-1)p^n. Integer logarithmic thresholds then give Pr(M>x)=Theta(x^-alpha (log x)^(m-1)), alpha=-log p/log B, no unjustified sharp constant because lattice oscillations. Comparing B^(rN) moments yields finiteness iff p B^r<1, including boundary divergence, and monotone inversion gives claimed extreme quantile order. Independently computed exact rational powers of T vs finite binomial sum through n=30 for m=3,p=1/2,c=1/4, checking sample survival 9/32,39/512,81/8192 at n=5,8,12. Formula is proved algebraically; finite checks only diagnostics. Inspected RESULT.md blob c81e34ed..., metadata and audit status files.
